text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to prohibit parking on the west side of Main Street, south of Hamstead Avenue, and on the south side of Hamstead Avenue, west of Main Street. This parking prohibition is intended to discourage motorists from parking on the curve in the road where Main Street and Hamstead Avenue intersect and should promote safe movement of traffic.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times, on the west side of Main Street, between Hamstead Avenue and a point 33 metres south. 2. Prohibited parking at all times, on the south side of Hamstead Avenue, between Main Street and a point 30 metres west. 3. Amended the parking prohibition in affect at all times, January, February, March, April, June, August, October and December on the west side of Main Street, between Doncaster Avenue and Hamstead Avenue, to be in effect from Doncaster Avenue to a point 33 metres south of Hamstead Avenue. 4. Amended the existing permit parking in effect in January, March, May, July, September and November, from 11:00 p.m. to 5:00 a.m., on the east side of Main Street, between Doncaster Avenue to Hamstead Avenue, to be in effect in January, February, March, April, June, August, October and December. 5.
